articles.title: ‘To Get PM’s Attention’: Woman Sets Vehicles Ablaze Outside High Court, Panic in Cuttack
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of alleged arson unfolded near the Orissa High Court in Cuttack on Tuesday (31 March 2026), where a 40-year-old woman reportedly set multiple vehicles on fire, claiming she wanted to draw the attention of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

body.html:
A shocking case of alleged arson unfolded near the Orissa High Court in Cuttack on Tuesday (31 March 2026), where a 40-year-old woman reportedly set multiple vehicles on fire, claiming she wanted to draw the attention of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

The accused, identified as Minati Sahu from Jagatsinghpur district, has been detained by police. According to officials, the incident occurred around 11:45 am outside the High Court gate, where she allegedly poured petrol on parked vehicles and set them ablaze.

The fire reportedly started with an electric vehicle and quickly spread to nearby motorcycles and an SUV. Thick smoke filled the area, triggering panic in the busy Chandni Chowk locality, with shops shutting down and people rushing to safety.

Fire services personnel present at the premises immediately attempted to control the blaze using extinguishers, while additional fire tenders later brought the situation under control. No injuries were reported.

Initially suspected to be a short circuit, the case took a serious turn after CCTV footage confirmed it was a deliberate act. The visuals allegedly show the woman pouring a flammable substance before igniting the vehicles. The footage is now a key part of the investigation.

During interrogation, Sahu reportedly admitted to the act, stating she wanted to highlight an issue directly to the Prime Minister. She also made claims of being “possessed by Goddess Durga” at the time, prompting police to suspect mental health concerns.

A minor child, believed to be around five years old, was reportedly with her during the incident.

Police have produced the accused before a court and initiated a detailed probe. Officials confirmed she is undergoing psychiatric evaluation, while further legal action is being pursued.

The incident has raised serious concerns over security arrangements in sensitive zones like court premises.

articles.title: Burqa-Clad Woman Pulls Gun, Loots Jewellery Shop in Broad Daylight in Ayodhya
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking daylight robbery, a masked woman looted a jewellery shop in Rudouli area of Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh. The incident occurred at Mahesh Jewellers, where the woman, dressed in a burqa, entered the shop posing as a customer.

body.html:
In a shocking daylight robbery, a masked woman looted a jewellery shop in Rudouli area of Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh.

The incident occurred at Mahesh Jewellers, where the woman, dressed in a burqa, entered the shop posing as a customer. She asked to see a gold necklace weighing around 26 grams and examined it calmly.

However, moments later, she pulled out a pistol and threatened the shopkeeper at gunpoint. Before anyone could react, she snatched the necklace and fled from the spot.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV footage, which police are now analysing to identify the accused.

The bold nature of the crime has raised serious security concerns in the area. Police have registered a case and launched an investigation to trace the suspect.

#Ayodhya #UttarPradesh #Robbery #BreakingNews #CrimeNews

articles.title: Midnight Kidnap Bid Foiled: Family Fights Off Armed Gang in Rajasthan Village
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking attempted abduction in Raniadeshipura village under Kalyanpur police station limits in Balotra district created panic late Wednesday night, after a group of armed criminals stormed a house but were forced to flee due to the family’s resistance.

body.html:
A shocking attempted abduction in Raniadeshipura village under Kalyanpur police station limits in Balotra district created panic late Wednesday night, after a group of armed criminals stormed a house but were forced to flee due to the family’s resistance.

According to reports, around 10–12 masked men arrived in two Scorpio vehicles and targeted the house of Narayanram Patel. The accused allegedly barged in and attempted to abduct a young woman from the house.

However, in a dramatic turn, family members acted swiftly and courageously confronted the attackers. Using sticks and household items, they resisted the gang, disrupting what police suspect was a pre-planned operation.

Caught off guard by the resistance, the criminals fled the scene. While escaping, they reportedly fired two rounds in the air to create panic in the area. The gunshots alerted nearby residents, who quickly gathered at the spot.

No injuries were reported, but the incident has left the village shaken.

Police recovered a magazine (ammunition clip) dropped by the accused at the scene, which is expected to be a key piece of evidence. CCTV footage from the area has also captured the incident, and efforts are underway to identify those involved.

Senior police officer Vikas Kumar reached the spot with a team and conducted a detailed inspection. A blockade has been set up in nearby areas, and search operations are ongoing.

Officials stated that the attack appears to be well-planned, and assured that the accused will be arrested soon. Meanwhile, the incident has raised serious concerns about safety and security among local residents.

articles.title: Toll Plaza Turns War Zone! Car Riders Smash Barriers One by One in Midnight Rampage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident from Etawah, chaos erupted at the Bakhtiyarpur toll plaza on the Bareilly Highway late Tuesday night after car occupants went on a destructive spree following a dispute with toll staff.

body.html:
In a shocking incident from Etawah, chaos erupted at the Bakhtiyarpur toll plaza on the Bareilly Highway late Tuesday night after car occupants went on a destructive spree following a dispute with toll staff.

According to reports, two men arrived at the toll plaza around 10 pm and initially interacted normally with the staff. However, their behaviour soon turned aggressive. The accused allegedly began driving recklessly at high speed, repeatedly ramming into toll barriers.

Eyewitnesses stated that the car made multiple rounds, smashing barrier after barrier while terrified staff struggled to stop them. The sudden violence created panic at the plaza, with workers fearing a major accident.

Toll employees suspect the occupants were under the influence of alcohol and enraged over toll payment. The entire incident was captured on CCTV, which is now being used to identify the accused.

Following a complaint by toll management, police registered a case at Chaubia police station and launched a search operation. Officials confirmed that strict action will be taken against those involved in vandalism and endangering lives.

In a later update, three accused — Sanjay Singh, Gaurav Yadav, and Deepu Singh — have been arrested in connection with the case.

#Etawah #TollPlazaChaos #ViralVideo #RoadRage #DrunkDriving

articles.title: Tractor Rampage in Nainital: Car Crushed 6 Times in Shocking Attack, Accused Held Within 12 Hours
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident of alleged attempted murder has surfaced from Nainital, where a tractor driver repeatedly rammed a parked car at a roadside dhaba, trapping occupants inside and creating panic. The incident took place on Tuesday night in the Chakluva area near a hillside restaurant.

body.html:
A shocking incident of alleged attempted murder has surfaced from Nainital, where a tractor driver repeatedly rammed a parked car at a roadside dhaba, trapping occupants inside and creating panic.

The incident took place on Tuesday night in the Chakluva area near a hillside restaurant. According to police, the victim, Himanshu Deupa, had arrived with friends and parked his car outside the dhaba when the accused allegedly targeted the vehicle.

Eyewitnesses said the tractor driver ran over the car nearly six times, smashing windows and severely damaging the vehicle while people inside screamed for help. Locals present at the scene rushed to rescue the trapped occupants, preventing a major tragedy.

Videos of the incident, along with CCTV footage, have surfaced on social media, showing the intensity of the attack.

Acting swiftly, police arrested the accused, identified as Praveen Singh Deupa, within 12 hours of the incident. The tractor used in the attack was seized, and an illegal .315-bore pistol was also recovered from his possession, leading to an additional case under the Arms Act.

Preliminary investigation suggests the attack may be linked to an old rivalry related to mining disputes, although the victim has denied any such conflict. A forensic team has examined the scene, and evidence has been collected.

Under the supervision of senior officials, including SSP Dr. Manjunath T.C., police tracked down the accused using surveillance and local intelligence. Authorities have reiterated a zero-tolerance policy towards such violent acts.

An FIR has been registered at Kaladhungi police station, and further investigation is underway.

#Nainital #BreakingNews #AttemptToMurder #ViralVideo #CrimeNews

articles.title: ‘Why Are You Taking Me?’ Man Detained Mid-Dinner in Lucknow, Viral Video Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic incident from Lucknow has triggered widespread debate after a man was allegedly picked up by police while dining with his family at a restaurant in Gomti Nagar.

body.html:
A dramatic incident from Lucknow has triggered widespread debate after a man was allegedly picked up by police while dining with his family at a restaurant in Gomti Nagar.

The incident reportedly took place at a restaurant in the Food Valley area, where the man was eating with his wife and young child when a group of police personnel—some in plain clothes—suddenly surrounded him and took him into custody.

Viral videos from the scene show the youth repeatedly asking, “Why are you taking me? At least tell me the reason,” while his wife and child can be seen distressed and crying. Eyewitnesses claimed that no clear explanation or warrant was presented at the spot.

The sudden action created chaos at the restaurant, drawing attention from other customers and locals. According to reports, the police team involved is believed to be from Thakurganj and Dubagga police station areas.

The incident has raised serious questions over police procedure, transparency, and the use of plainclothes personnel in such operations. Many on social media have criticised the manner of detention, calling it intimidating and insensitive, especially in front of family members.

As of now, no official statement has been released by the police clarifying the reason behind the detention or the circumstances leading to the action.

#Lucknow #BreakingNews #UPPolice #ViralVideo

articles.title: ‘Accident or Murder?’ Woman’s Death in Rampur Sparks Dowry Killing Allegations After CCTV Surfaces
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 22-year-old married woman’s death in Rampur has triggered serious allegations of dowry harassment and murder, with her family claiming she was deliberately pushed off a moving bike.

body.html:
A 22-year-old married woman’s death in Rampur has triggered serious allegations of dowry harassment and murder, with her family claiming she was deliberately pushed off a moving bike.

The deceased, identified as Aarti, succumbed to her injuries during treatment after an incident on the night of March 25. Her family has lodged a case at Ganj police station against her husband Vishal, alleging dowry death.

According to the family, Aarti had been facing harassment and physical abuse over dowry demands since her marriage, which took place just over a year ago. They claim the situation worsened over time, with repeated instances of violence.

A key piece of evidence submitted to the police is a CCTV video reportedly recorded at 1:47 am, showing Aarti falling from a moving motorcycle. However, the family alleges that it was not an accident but a deliberate act, claiming Vishal pushed her off the bike after assaulting her.

It is further alleged that prior to the incident, Aarti was forced to dance at a birthday party in Mohanpura village and was beaten when she refused. While returning from the event, the accused allegedly assaulted her again and then pushed her from the bike on a deserted road.

Police have sent the body for post-mortem and initiated an investigation. Jitendra Kumar stated that a case has been registered and further action will depend on medical reports and other evidence.

Authorities have said that the exact sequence of events will be established after a thorough investigation.

#Rampur #BreakingNews #DowryDeath #CrimeNews #UPPolice

articles.title: Love Marriage Turns Fatal in Ghaziabad: Man Allegedly Killed by In-Laws, Family Protests on Road
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case has emerged from the Loni area of Ghaziabad, where a 32-year-old man was allegedly beaten to death by his in-laws, just a year after his interfaith love marriage.

body.html:
A shocking case has emerged from the Loni area of Ghaziabad, where a 32-year-old man was allegedly beaten to death by his in-laws, just a year after his interfaith love marriage.

The deceased, identified as Nitin Kumar (also referred to as Nitin Rathi), had married Muskan in 2025 despite opposition from her family. The couple had reportedly been facing ongoing tension since the marriage. Muskan, who is currently nine months pregnant, had recently returned to her parents’ home following a dispute.

According to the FIR lodged at Tila Mod police station, Nitin was called to the Banthala area on March 30 under the pretext of resolving the dispute. His brother Amit Kumar alleged that Nitin was taken in a car by his in-laws, including father-in-law Mehruddin and uncle Asif Ali, along with other associates.

During the journey, suspicion arose, and after stopping near a deserted stretch in Bhandeda village, the accused allegedly attacked Nitin. Amit managed to escape and alerted police, while Nitin was reportedly strangled and left unconscious near a culvert.

Police rushed Nitin to hospital, from where he was referred to GTB Hospital in Delhi, where doctors declared him dead.

Based on the complaint, police have registered a murder case and arrested two accused—Mehruddin and Asif Ali—while search operations are underway to nab the remaining suspects.

Atul Kumar Singh stated that multiple teams have been formed to trace the absconding accused and that the investigation is being carried out seriously.

Following the incident, enraged family members staged a protest by placing the body on the Loni-Bhopura Road near Banthala flyover, causing a traffic jam for nearly 30 minutes. Police later pacified the protesters and restored normal traffic after assuring strict action.

The incident has sparked outrage and raised concerns over violence linked to interfaith marriages and family disputes.

#Ghaziabad #BreakingNews #LoveMarriage #MurderCase

articles.title: Exam Day Horror: Two Sisters Fall Off Moving KSRTC Bus After Door Opens Mid-Journey
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident from Dakshina Kannada district, two school students—both sisters—were injured after falling from a moving KSRTC bus while on their way to write their Class 10 board examinations.

body.html:
In a shocking incident from Dakshina Kannada district, two school students—both sisters—were injured after falling from a moving KSRTC bus while on their way to write their Class 10 board examinations.

The accident occurred near Reshme Road in Kaliya village of Beltangady taluk near Mangaluru. The siblings had boarded the bus at Gerukatte while travelling from Puttur to Dharmasthala.

According to reports, the bus was carrying around 86 passengers, forcing the girls to stand near the door due to lack of space. As the bus approached a curve, the door allegedly flung open suddenly, causing the elder sister to lose balance and fall onto the road. The younger sister, who tried to hold on, was also pulled down.

Eyewitnesses and CCTV footage show the sequence of events, highlighting how both girls were thrown out of the moving vehicle within seconds.

Both students sustained injuries and were immediately shifted to a nearby private hospital for treatment. Their condition is reported to be stable.

The incident has raised serious concerns over passenger safety and overcrowding in public transport. The Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC) is expected to initiate an investigation into the matter.

#Karnataka #Mangaluru #KSRTC #BreakingNews #RoadSafety

articles.title: Out-of-Control Truck Sparks Highway Chaos in Muzaffarnagar: Biker Duo Narrowly Escape Death
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major road accident on the Delhi–Dehradun National Highway 58 in Muzaffarnagar has raised serious concerns over road safety after an overloaded truck rammed into a motorcycle, with CCTV footage of the incident going viral.

body.html:
A major road accident on the Delhi–Dehradun National Highway 58 in Muzaffarnagar has raised serious concerns over road safety after an overloaded truck rammed into a motorcycle, with CCTV footage of the incident going viral.

The accident occurred near Ganpati Dhaba, close to Bagowali Chowki under Nai Mandi police station limits. According to reports, the truck rear-ended a bike carrying a young man and woman, causing them to fall onto the road.

In a narrow escape, both victims avoided being crushed under the truck by quickly pulling their legs away while falling. The bike was completely damaged in the collision.

Eyewitnesses claimed that the truck’s brakes had failed, leading to the accident. After hitting the motorcycle, the driver allegedly attempted to flee but lost control of the vehicle, crashing into multiple vehicles, including a Scorpio and an Alto car, causing further damage.

The young man sustained minor injuries, while the woman was reported safe.

Locals present at the scene chased and caught the driver. In the chaos, some people reportedly assaulted him before others intervened and brought the situation under control.

Police reached the spot, detained the driver, and cleared the damaged vehicles to restore traffic movement.

The incident, which took place last Tuesday, came into the spotlight after CCTV footage surfaced and went viral on Monday, triggering fresh concerns over overloaded vehicles and enforcement of traffic norms.

#Muzaffarnagar #BreakingNews #RoadAccident #ViralVideo
